How to start a new sport
as an adult beginner
Pick a sport with a beginner group. Climbing gyms, running clubs and boxing classes all have sessions made for people starting from zero.
Expect to be bad for a few weeks. Everyone else was a beginner once. The awkward phase passes faster than you think.
Book a few lessons with a coach. Good technique from the start prevents injuries and makes progress much quicker.
Go at the same time every week. A fixed slot in your calendar turns a new hobby into a real habit.
Before: I thought I was too old to start anything. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and learning feels exciting again.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I thought I was too old to start anything. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Learning feels exciting again.

slides.texte_overlay: Make friends at the club. Sport is one of the easiest ways for adults to meet new people with a shared passion.
Track small wins. Your first full session, your first race, your first grade. Progress is the best motivation there is.
